name: Magazine feature
description: A broad visual opening followed by an offset reading column, with room for photographs and display quotes. For profiles, interviews, and illustrated features.
structure: A large headline, optional kicker, standfirst, and byline open the feature without a separate cover.
The opening visual spans the page's full content width; its caption stays with it.
Body text flows in a narrower column offset to the right, with flush paragraphs and open spacing.
Optional display quotes interrupt the reading rhythm in normal flow. References follow the body; page numbers sit quietly below.
